Privacy

Fully offline local observatory.

SSM-JA is designed as a local, standalone Jyotish observatory. It does not require login, cloud storage, runtime servers, or external integration.

Execution Fully local and standalone.
Calculation Embedded astronomical cycle data and local mathematical computation. No runtime ephemeris dependency.
Connectivity No cloud sync, account system, runtime server, or external integration is required for core functionality.
Storage No chart inputs, Panchang selections, Transit selections, or session history are stored.
Local Storage Used only when users explicitly add custom locations not already present in the built-in location system.

Usage

Observation, location behavior, and responsibility.

SSM-JA is intended for observational, educational, and research-oriented use.

Location Transit and Panchang use the selected place. Users may select places manually from Input, Transit, or Panchang screens.
Date & Time Date and time may use the computer clock. Users may also edit them manually.
Permission No browser location permission is required in this version.
Observation Outputs are for observation, study, and reproducibility.
Save Save is provided only for user-added custom locations not already present in the built-in location system.
Responsibility Provided as-is. Users remain responsible for their device, browser, environment, safety, and security practices.

About

Offline deterministic Jyotish calculation kernel.

JA is a single-file offline Jyotish Atlas for calculation, observation, and reproducibility.

AyanamsaChitra Paksha compatible sidereal golden kernel.
RangeEmbedded 1900–2100 golden structure. Supported input range: 01 Jan 1950 to 31 Dec 2100. No runtime ephemeris API, internet call, or manual CSV loading is required.
ApproachDeterministic Chitra Paksha planetary-cycle resolution from an embedded golden structure. Offline calculation reduces runtime ephemeris noise, interpolation drift, and external dependency variation.
ScopeObservation and research only. Not for critical decision-making.
Verification200+ charts manually verified across ephemeris-dependent systems. Automated validation in progress following SSM-JTK methodology.

SSM-JA scoring info (generic)
This is a generic description of what the scoring engine considers (BPHS-inspired). It does not depend on the current chart.
Natal layer
  • Functional benefic / malefic by Lagna (default)
  • House lordship and house occupancy (whole-sign houses)
  • Dignity: own sign / exaltation / debilitation
  • Dispositor chaining (house and planet gates)
  • Neecha-bhanga / cancellation gates (where applicable)
  • Argala / virodh-argala gates
  • Drishti (graha drishti): all planets 7th; Mars 4/8; Jupiter 5/9; Saturn 3/10; Rahu/Ketu 5/7/9
Dasha + Transit layers
  • Dasha / antara weighting (planet-specific influence gates)
  • Transit activation / disruption gates
  • Blended output: activation vs disruption vs sustenance
  • Conservative guardrails (no hardcoded event claims)
Note: "Drishti" is scored as a supportive or stressing modifier on the house being scored, based on benefic/malefic aspect presence (and "major" drishti strength).
